page.layout: One column of index entries with page numbers at the right, under a centred "Z." letter heading and the Hebrew entry; below them the word FINIS, then a woodcut vase ornament (described in notes).

main_text.l: Voluisse in magnis etiam sat est. | 140
Urbanus VIII. Papa R. Græcos aliosqve orien-
talis Ecclesiæ populos ad fidem Ecclesiæ Rom.

page.notes: The Hebrew entry at the top of the Z group is a word of two or three letters with a long stroke; the letters are not clear enough to read with certainty. The "34" stands alone on its own line between "ejusdem autor putatur Hieronymus." and "ejusdem mendæ & vitia.", and seems to belong to the line above. Numbers at the first entry (540) and the Urbanus entry (39) are blurred. A woodcut of a flowering vase with scrolled handles fills the lower half of the page; it is an ornament, not text. A small mark at the top right corner is not transcribed. No running head or page number is printed.
